title: Korean Skincare Brand MDP+ Launches at Seven Nordstrom Stores - Retail News Asia

 Why it matters
 South Korea's MDP+ enters physical US retail across seven Nordstrom department stores, Nordstrom.com, and nationwide off-price Nordstrom Rack doors in November 2026. 
 Splitting rollouts between full-line counters and discount racks threatens margins, despite proven demand from over 450,000 TikTok and e-commerce sun stick sales. 
 Department store operators will evaluate whether social media volume converts into repeat mall foot traffic before committing to expand beyond the initial seven locations. 
 Retail News Asia newsroom analysis
 South Korean derma skincare brand MDP+ announced its entry into Nordstrom in November 2026, marking its debut in the US department store channel across seven locations, Nordstrom.com, and nationwide Nordstrom Rack doors.
 The physical department store rollout will phase across locations in Seattle, Oak Brook, Mission Viejo, Arcadia, Frisco, Coral Gables, and Honolulu. It transitions an American footprint previously focused on cross-border e-commerce and social platforms into major department store counters.
 MDP+, the US brand of Seoul-based MEDIPEEL, built initial domestic traction on Amazon, Olive Young Global, and TikTok Shop, where its flagship Peptide 9 Bio Sun Stick Pro moved over 450,000 units.
 Wholesale expansion beyond social commerce
 MDP+ operates as the export vehicle for MEDIPEEL, a Seoul-based beauty manufacturer with fifteen years in Korean esthetic dermatology. The US brand gained traction through e-commerce channels including Amazon, Olive Young Global and TikTok Shop, where its Peptide 9 Bio Sun Stick Pro moved over 450,000 units.
 Nordstrom’s online portal and its off-price chain Nordstrom Rack will carry an expanded assortment of eight products. The physical rollout covers high-traffic regional malls including Oakbrook Center in Illinois and Ala Moana Center in Hawaii, putting targeted anti-aging and sun protection lines directly in front of domestic department store shoppers.
 Department store economics versus discount racks
 Securing shelf space in full-line department stores gives Asian indie beauty labels credibility, yet splitting an initial launch between seven mainline Nordstrom stores and the nationwide off-price Rack network carries operational friction. Department store floor space demands high sales velocity per square foot, backed by marketing spend and customer education that viral digital brands often struggle to replicate offline.
 Relying on off-price channels at the start of a brand’s brick-and-mortar lifecycle creates margin pressure. When full-line stores price products as premium derma-cosmetics while adjacent discount branches stock expanded assortments, retail operators risk training consumers to wait for markdowns. Beauty brands that scale sustainably in North America typically protect their department store pricing for several quarters before feeding secondary discount pipelines.
 Building out the product assortment
 The core lineup features the Peptide 9 range, targeted neck formulas including the Collagen Naite Thread Neck Cream and the Naite 1000 Shot Neck Stick, alongside products from the brand’s Red Lacto Collagen collection. Ingredients such as peptides, collagen and PDRN remain the main hook for Western buyers seeking clinical Korean formulations.
 The extended product slate rolling out across Nordstrom Rack includes the Red Lacto Collagen Wrapping Mask, Clear Foam Cleanser, Cleansing Oil, and two Peptide 9 Pro treatments. Department store buyers will track whether volume from TikTok translates into repeat foot traffic across the initial seven locations before committing to further full-line expansion.

 Deploying nationwide Nordstrom Rack doors alongside just seven full-line counters will backfire if markdowns cannibalise premium positioning. While MEDIPEEL used fifteen years of Korean esthetic dermatology to drive digital traction through Olive Young Global and social platforms, physical department stores demand high sales velocity per square foot. Pushing discount inventory immediately strains retail margins and pressures full-price counters that require consumer education. This approach risks training shoppers to bypass full-line stores in favour of discount branches. Watch whether customer demand triggers full-line department store expansion beyond the initial seven doors.
 Wei Zhang
 Questions & Answers
 Q. Which physical Nordstrom locations are included in the brand's department store rollout?
 A. The initial physical launch spans seven regional department stores situated in Seattle, Oak Brook, Mission Viejo, Arcadia, Frisco, Coral Gables, and Honolulu. These department store counters include high-traffic regional shopping centres such as Oakbrook Center in Illinois and Ala Moana Center in Hawaii.
 Q. Why does simultaneously launching in Nordstrom Rack present a risk for the brand?
 A. Stocking products in off-price discount stores alongside full-line department counters creates margin pressure and risks training shoppers to await markdowns. Viral digital labels usually protect full-price department store margins for several quarters before supplying secondary discount networks to ensure sustainable retail growth.
 Q. How did MDP+ establish its presence in the United States prior to this retail expansion?
 A. The brand initially built domestic sales momentum through cross-border e-commerce and social platforms, including Amazon, Olive Young Global, and TikTok Shop. Its flagship product, the Peptide 9 Bio Sun Stick Pro, achieved notable commercial traction by selling more than 450,000 units across these digital channels.
 Q. What specific products make up the range being distributed through Nordstrom Rack?
 A. Nordstrom Rack is stocking an extended eight-product assortment that features the Red Lacto Collagen Wrapping Mask, Clear Foam Cleanser, and Cleansing Oil. The discount chain’s lineup also incorporates two Peptide 9 Pro treatments alongside the brand’s targeted collagen and peptide skincare formulations.
